title: Soundcheck
summary: Johnny asks V to stand on an empty club stage at dawn, say one word into the mic, and give him one line in V's own voice.
description: Johnny wants to stand on a stage once more with nobody watching. He asks V to meet him at the empty Totentanz stage in Westbrook at five in the morning.

start.bringUp: You have wanted to stand on a stage once more with nobody watching. Bring up, in your own way and without a joke, that V should go to the Totentanz stage in Westbrook at five in the morning and stand by the mic.

stage.name: the Totentanz stage in Westbrook, empty at five in the morning

street.name: a Westbrook street at first light, outside the club

SH6.open.01.text: I'm not asking for a favour. I'm asking for a room.

SH6.open.02.text: An empty stage. Five in the morning. No crowd. No band. Just a soundcheck.

SH6.open.03.text: You've been carrying me around for weeks. I never asked. I'm asking.

SH6.stage.venue.01.text: There it is. Mic's where it always was. Stand by it.

SH6.stage.venue.02.text: Smell that? Spilled beer and cables. Nobody ever bottled that.

SH6.stage.check.01.text: Soundcheck. The part nobody sees. You hear the room breathe.

SH6.stage.check.02.text: Say one word into it. Anything. Your name.

SH6.stage.check.03.text: That's your voice, V. Not mine. It sounds fine.

SH6.stage.check.04.text: Quiet's good. You can feel it work.

SH6.stage.wheel.01.text: Listen. I've used your body for weeks. Walked it, watched it, never asked once.

SH6.stage.wheel.02.text: I won't take the wheel. Not unless you hand it to me. One line. Your mouth. Your call.

SH6.stage.wheel.03.text: You can say no. I'd respect that more than a yes.

SH6.stage.wheel.04.text: Thanks. Mine's short. Alt. Just the name, said right, once.

SH6.stage.wheel.05.text: No. Good. I'm relieved, which surprises me. You're not my vehicle, V.

SH6.stage.wheel.06.text: Turns, then. You pick one, I pick another. We'll call it a duet and never say so.

SH6.stage.out.01.text: Let's go. The lights will come on soon. I don't want to see it.

SH6.stage.out.02.text: Look at that. Dawn on a Westbrook street. I used to hate it.

SH6.wheel.caption.text: Don't look. It's only the mirror.

SH6.close.01.text: Whatever's left of me, I owe you a line. That was it.

SH6.close.02.text: You told me no. Nobody does that. I'm keeping it.

SH6.close.03.text: You left before the end. That's alright. The room's still there.

g1.asks: Will you take me? No jokes from me tonight. I promise.
g1.know: The Totentanz stage in Westbrook at five in the morning, and the club is empty. Johnny is asking, not taking, and V can say no.
g1.secret: He has already thought about the question he will ask on stage.

g2.asks: What's it feel like, standing up there with the lights off? Tell me. I forgot.
g2.know: V is at the mic stand for ten minutes. Johnny is walking the edge of the stage, and V may say a word or stay silent.
g2.secret: He is a little afraid of the quiet.
g2.wants: V to speak, or not, and for him to hear the room.

g3.asks: One line, from your mouth, in your words. Do I get it?
g3.know: Three options: yes, where V writes the line in chat and Johnny answers in his own voice, no, or together, where you take turns on a line. The mod never moves V.
g3.secret: He is afraid this body will outlast him and that V will keep carrying his voice.

stages.label: Johnny asks V for a soundcheck
stages.objective: Answer Johnny's request for a soundcheck
stages.know: Johnny is asking V for a soundcheck on the Totentanz stage at five in the morning. He is asking, not taking, and V can say no.
stages.wants: V to say yes or no.

stages.label: Stand by the mic on the Totentanz stage
stages.objective: Go to the Totentanz stage in Westbrook with Johnny before dawn
stages.know: V is going to the Totentanz stage in Westbrook, empty at five in the morning. Johnny is waiting, and the mic stand is where it always was.
stages.wants: V to stand on the stage within reach of the mic stand.

stages.label: Stand on the stage during the soundcheck
stages.objective: Stand by the mic on the Totentanz stage with Johnny
stages.know: V is on the Totentanz stage at five in the morning, near the mic stand. Johnny walks the edge of the stage and tells V what the room used to sound like. He is a little afraid of the quiet.
stages.wants: V to say one word into the mic, or to stay silent and let him hear the room.

stages.label: Johnny asks for one line in V's own voice
stages.objective: Answer Johnny's request for one line in V's voice
stages.know: Johnny has used V's body for weeks and never asked. Now he asks for one line, spoken by V's mouth. V may say yes, say no, or take turns with him. Alt's name may come up in the answer to yes.
stages.wants: V to decide: yes, no, or together.

stages.label: Walk out to the street at dawn
stages.objective: Walk out to the Westbrook street at dawn with Johnny
stages.know: The soundcheck is over and V has given Johnny the line. The lights are coming on soon, and he is quiet.
stages.wants: V to walk out by the front onto the street.

stages.label: Walk out to the street at dawn
stages.objective: Walk out to the Westbrook street at dawn with Johnny
stages.know: The soundcheck is over and you and Johnny have traded the line in turns. The lights are coming on soon, and he is quiet.
stages.wants: V to walk out by the front onto the street.

stages.label: Walk out to the street at dawn
stages.objective: Walk out to the Westbrook street at dawn with Johnny
stages.know: The soundcheck is over and V has told Johnny no. The lights are coming on soon, and he is quiet.
stages.wants: V to walk out by the front onto the street.

wheel-yes.memory: In an empty club at dawn Johnny asked for a line instead of taking it, and you gave him one in your own voice.
wheel-yes.history: He never says 'my body' of V's again.

wheel-together.memory: In an empty club at dawn you and Johnny took turns with one line each, and he called it a duet.

wheel-no.memory: You told Johnny no in an empty club at dawn, and he respected it more than a yes.

venue-left.memory: You left Johnny before the soundcheck was over.

no.memory: You said no to Johnny's soundcheck, and he said not tonight.
